# ARC corpus (Architecture of Relational Coherence), by Filipe Bastos

> An independent research corpus, written in French. It is not a theory, and not a theory of everything: it holds that no single thing explains everything, because everything is relative to its context. It rests on no axiom. It is a reading, made of several elements (the figure, the nine positions, the pairs, the empty centre, the relation), applied at every scale. It rereads mathematics, physics, the living world and society from a single figure, two concentric circles with a square between them, and the constant k = 1/2 it imposes (the ratio of the radii is √2/2, whose square is ½); the operation 1 ⊕ 1 = 3 and the cadastre of nine positions (1 to 9, involution φ(x) = 9 − x, centre 4.5) follow from it. Every statement carries an explicit status: Theorem (finite computation, verified by an attached script), Fact (received science, with sources), Reading (the author's interpretation, declared as such), Prediction (dated, with its refutation criterion), Open problem. 12 volumes, version 1.0, October 2026. License CC BY 4.0. Each volume page gives an English abstract.

Main language: French. French index: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/llms-fr.txt

## Volumes
- [Volume 0, Le Seuil](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v00-le-seuil/): The entrance to the ARC corpus (Architecture of Relational Coherence). PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_00_le_seuil.pdf
- [Volume 1, La Fondation](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v01-la-fondation/): The essential volume of the ARC corpus. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_01_la_fondation.pdf
- [Volume 2, La Figure](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v02-la-figure/): Everything the ARC corpus says about its root figure: two concentric circles with a square between them. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_02_la_figure.pdf
- [Volume 3, Le Code et le Registre](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v03-le-code-et-le-registre/): Three parts. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_03_le_code_et_le_registre.pdf
- [Volume 4, La Théorie des Nombres](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v04-la-theorie-des-nombres/): The whole number theory of the ARC corpus in one book. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_04_la_theorie_des_nombres.pdf
- [Volume 5, Les Grands Problèmes](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v05-les-grands-problemes/): What the ARC corpus has written on four Millennium Prize problems: the Riemann hypothesis, P versus NP, Navier-Stokes regularity and the Yang-Mills mass gap. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_05_les_grands_problemes.pdf
- [Volume 6, L'Histoire de la Preuve](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v06-l-histoire-de-la-preuve/): What the ARC corpus says about proof: what it is, what it forgot, how it was received, who showed their proofs and who kept them in a drawer, and why the question of why never receives an answer. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_06_l_histoire_de_la_preuve.pdf
- [Volume 7, La Physique relue](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v07-la-physique-relue/): What the ARC corpus says about physics, in one sentence: measurement is projection. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_07_la_physique_relue.pdf
- [Volume 8, La Matière et le Cosmos](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v08-la-matiere-et-le-cosmos/): What the ARC corpus says about matter, the cosmos and their thermodynamics, from the smallest to the largest. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_08_la_matiere_et_le_cosmos.pdf
- [Volume 9, Le Vivant](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v09-le-vivant/): What the ARC corpus says about life, from a thesis set out in May 2026: identity, life and consciousness are not three phenomena to be linked by a theory of emergence, but three names of a single operation seen from three disciplines. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_09_le_vivant.pdf
- [Volume 10, La Conscience et la Peine](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v10-la-conscience-et-la-peine/): Six pieces of the ARC corpus devoted to the mind, gathered into one book. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_10_la_conscience_et_la_peine.pdf
- [Volume 11, La Cité et le Sens](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v11-la-cite-et-le-sens/): What the ARC corpus says about common life and meaning. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_11_la_cite_et_le_sens.pdf

## Short papers (French)
- [Modulo](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Modulo_v2_0.pdf): Modulo: 225 years of amputated mathematics and science. The case against reduction to the remainder, with its theorems, sign-free inversions and sources.
- [P-B-1](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/P-B-1_les_pingouins.pdf): P-B-1: the LHC penguins. Pre-registered prediction on the b → s μμ anomaly (deadline 31 December 2030), SHA-256 4079d4ae…a686.
- [Benford without Napier](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Benford_sans_Neper_v0_1.pdf): Benford without Napier: the first digit is a count of turns, not a logarithmic law (v0.1, 26 October 2026, in French).
- [The Heegner numbers in the code](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Les_nombres_de_Heegner_dans_le_code.pdf): The Heegner numbers in the code: nine numbers fixed by a theorem, arranged as mirrors around closure (163 = 1-9-1).
- [The native tables](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Les_Tables_Natives_v0_2.pdf): The native tables: two pages to redo with a pencil.
- [The three bodies never moved](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Les_trois_corps_n_ont_jamais_bouge.pdf): The three bodies never moved: truncation, Noether and Poincaré.
- [The basement of dark matter](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Le_sous_sol_de_la_matiere_noire.pdf): The basement of dark matter: what the measurement assumes before measuring (175 SPARC galaxies).
- [The remainder and the turns](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Le_Reste_et_les_Tours.pdf): The remainder and the turns: what reduction to the remainder throws away, and its cost.
- [How to bring ARC down](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Faire_tomber_ARC.pdf): How to bring ARC down: the complete table of the 179 statements with Prediction status across the twelve volumes, copied with their address (v2.0, 26 October 2026).

## Author
- Filipe Bastos, born 1976 in Quebec, son of Portuguese immigrants. Biography (French): https://bastosfilipe.com/bio/
